title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1971-12-01
lineage: AUDMC > C > C > CDR > EAC > Pitch Correction / editing > SHN

ai_review.summary: Mixed‑quality audience recording of a 1971 show that captures high energy and a standout Cryptical → Other One segment, but suffers from distant and uneven sound.
ai_review.review: The tape offers an authentic feel of the 1971 concert with enthusiastic crowd reactions and a memorable Cryptical > The Other One > Uncle John’s Band sequence. Opinions on the audio are split – some listeners praise its clarity for an audience source, while others find it muffled and distant. Overall the performance is solid, but the inconsistent recording quality limits its appeal.

ai_rating.rationale: Star ratings range from 0 to 5 with many low scores for sound quality and several high scores praising the show, resulting in an average around 2.7; weighted consideration of both performance and recording yields a moderate 3‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviews mention distant, muffled vocals and overall awful sound, but others describe clear vocals and crisp mix for an audience tape; inconsistency suggests a fair‑to‑poor technical presentation.

standout_songs: Cryptical > The Other One > Uncle John’s Band
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is the only part available in this AUD; second set exists as an SBD elsewhere. Listeners note energetic crowd interaction and a solid flow despite limited source material.
